importer_axis_contract.authority: installed Isaac Sim 4.5 URDF importer and PhysX USD schemas
importer_axis_contract.observed_importer_behavior: Isaac Sim warns that non-primary URDF axes are aligned to a PhysX X primary axis by rotating the imported body and joint local frames; in the generated USD, an unauthored physics:axis therefore means the PhysX X fallback
importer_axis_contract.runtime_requirement: Each Isaac dynamics validation must record the imported USD primary axis and local frame, reconstruct its zero-pose world axis, and verify directed alignment with this source contract
importer_axis_contract.source_interpretation: axis_world_zero_pose is computed from the current URDF kinematic chain; it is not inferred from the joint name and is not assumed to remain the authored USD primary axis

zero_pose_ground_support.method: collision mesh vertices within tolerance of the zero-pose minimum Z

stability_hypothesis.installed_api_reference: Isaac Lab 0.36.1 isaaclab_assets.robots.unitree.H1_CFG feet actuator uses stiffness=20 and damping=4

observed_failure.contact_sequence: toe contacts unload before the forward fall while both feet remain loaded
observed_failure.interpretation: initial contact excites an underdamped sagittal ankle-rocking mode

stability_hypothesis.scope: left and right ankle-pitch damping only
